body_markdown:
[IVE](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6RHTUrRF63xao58xh9FXYJ) is


*so* back. To celebrate the release of the K-Pop group’s highly anticipated new EP,


[Looks Can Kill](https://open.spotify.com/album/7iGqCu6Ny5cKSfub5sBibf) , the Spotify DIVE ACADEMY hosted an exclusive live show for fans (aka DIVEs) in Seoul on October 19 that kicked off their next era. Now, DIVEs around the world can relive the night with newly released videos from the event.


These official videos feature the first-ever live performances of their new tracks, “


[Looks Can Kill](https://open.spotify.com/track/5aQzVYFjWBEEyvjgpMelKe?autoplay_ok=1) ” and “


[Girls Girls Girls](https://open.spotify.com/track/1LNVt5WZB1NptvoYtEuVdP?autoplay_ok=1) ” plus longtime favorite “


[BANG BANG](https://open.spotify.com/track/4oVCRpwrS2UaWrdKdxFXJU?si=nFe3olyGQSO3gZ3SZ5mpjg&amp%3Butm_source=copy-link&nd=1&dlsi=6a8b55e45c984c46&autoplay_ok=1) .”


Spotify has also released a


[video podcast](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4ncuKCpCvQKRUc6XC1qz9H) featuring the talk session from the night, where IVE reflected on their comeback and gave DIVEs a peek into what’s next.


“We’re so grateful to Spotify for creating this special opportunity to make unforgettable memories with our DIVEs,” said IVE member


**ANYUJIN** at the Spotify DIVE ACADEMY. “Being able to meet and spend time with our fans in person on such an important day made the experience even more meaningful and memorable.”


NEXT


The live show capped off three days of the Spotify DIVE ACADEMY. On October 17 and 18, fans stepped into an immersive superhero movie set inspired by the group’s return as “Girl Heroes.” Interactive zones packed with easter eggs from the new EP invited guests to take on special missions, see themselves as heroes, and discover the world of


*Looks Can Kill* . Made for the DIVEs who know IVE best, the event was just one more way Spotify creates unique experiences that connect artists and fans around the world.


*Watch all of the Spotify DIVE ACADEMY performance videos now.*
